title: ArcadeDB from 26.11.1-SNAPSHOT before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated…
description: ArcadeDB versions from 26.11.1-SNAPSHOT up to but not including 26.11.1 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users to bypass per-type access control checks when opening a database on demand. Exploitation involves sending a specially crafted POST request to a closed database, enabling unauthorized read and write access to data types.
